text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak and King Juan Carlos of Spain discuss the peace process, bilateral relations and negotiations on the Egyptian-European association agreement. Juan Carlos stresses his support for Mubarak's call to achieve international cooperation in the fight against terrorism.
- Businessmen agree on setting up an airline company with a capital of 100 million pounds ($29 million).
- Agriculture Minister Youssef Wali tells an international conference that Egypt will increase its fertiliser production to 8.5 million tonnes from 6.5 million a year.

- Transport Minister Soleiman Metwalli says construction work at a bridge across the Suez Canal will start within three months. The bridge will cost some $120 million, he says after receiving a Japanese delegation.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa says after the Mubarak-Carlos talks that an Israeli peace is impossible, and there should be a balanced peace.
- Mubarak will receive Roza Otunbayeva, foreign minister of Kyrgyzstan, today. The minister arrived in Cairo on Monday for a three-day visit.
- Ibrahim Bare Mainassara, President of Niger, will start a three-day visit to Egypt next Monday. Mubarak will meet Mainassara on his arrival.
